name: aura
title: Aura
description: Wraps content in an animated luminous aura with color, material, size, and speed variants.

docs.usage: Wrap a single child with Aura. The child remains directly inside the wrapper, so buttons, inputs, cards, and custom components work without structural changes. Choose a visual variant and size, then use class to match the wrapper radius to your content. Pass color for a single CSS color or colors for a custom multi-color palette. Background colors and animation durations are also customizable, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

moreExamples.description: Choose from default, dual, rainbow, holo, glow, gold, and silver treatments.

moreExamples.title: Sizes and customization
moreExamples.description: Control aura thickness, CSS colors, backdrop color, and animation duration.

docs.usage: Compose Root, Messages, Message, Content, and Composer. Message defaults to the right side; pass side="left" for incoming messages. Bind Composer's value and handle messages with onSend.

docs.usage: Pass package-manager command prefixes through values and the shared package or CLI arguments through script. Install joins them with one space and remembers the active manager.

name: holographic
title: Holographic
description: Applies an animated holographic spectrum and shimmer over any content.

docs.usage: Wrap any content and optionally pass CSS color values. Shape and border radius are controlled through class; no radius is applied by default. Empty color arrays use the built-in spectrum, and reduced-motion preferences are respected.

moreExamples.name: intensity
moreExamples.title: Intensity and speed
moreExamples.description: Tune the shimmer from barely-there polish to a stronger accent and control its duration.

moreExamples.name: content
moreExamples.title: Any shape or content
moreExamples.description: Apply the effect to interactive controls and cards while owning the shape entirely through Tailwind classes.

name: stat
title: Stat
description: Displays related numbers and supporting data in composable horizontal, vertical, or responsive blocks.

docs.usage: Compose Root, Item, Title, Value, and Description. Add Figure for an icon or image and Actions for controls. Root defaults to a horizontal layout; use vertical or responsive when the stats should stack, including on smaller screens.

moreExamples.name: dashboard
moreExamples.title: Responsive dashboard
moreExamples.description: Combine figures, semantic colors, and multiple values in a layout that stacks on smaller screens.

moreExamples.name: actions
moreExamples.title: Actions and alignment
moreExamples.description: Add controls or center individual stat items with ordinary Tailwind classes.

name: steps
title: Steps
description: Shows progress through a sequence with composable steps, states, colors, and responsive orientations.

docs.usage: Compose Root and Item. Root controls horizontal, vertical, or responsive layout. Each Item accepts a pending, current, or complete state and an optional semantic color variant. Pass indicator as text, a number, or a snippet for icons and custom markup. The underlying ordered list preserves the process order for assistive technology.

moreExamples.name: directions
moreExamples.title: Vertical and responsive
moreExamples.description: Use a vertical sequence or switch automatically from vertical on mobile to horizontal on larger screens.

moreExamples.name: variants
moreExamples.title: Colors and custom indicators
moreExamples.description: Communicate success, warnings, and errors with semantic variants and snippet-based indicator content.

name: tooltip
title: Tooltip
description: Displays concise contextual information on hover, keyboard focus, or touch-friendly tap.

docs.usage: Wrap a single control or element and pass content as text or a snippet. The tooltip opens on pointer hover and keyboard focus, toggles on touch tap, closes on outside interaction or Escape, avoids viewport edges, and keeps a mobile-safe maximum width. Keep tooltip content concise and non-interactive; use a popover for buttons or form controls.

moreExamples.name: placements
moreExamples.title: Placement
moreExamples.description: Position the tooltip on any side while collision handling keeps it inside the viewport.

moreExamples.name: content
moreExamples.title: Rich content
moreExamples.description: Use a snippet for concise formatted content while preserving tooltip semantics.
